description: This file defines the 'Std' class which implements the 'RouteParser' interface within the FastRoute library. It provides methods to parse route strings with optional segments and placeholders into structured data for route matching.

classes.name: Std
classes.description: Implements route string parsing with support for optional segments and placeholders using regex patterns.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a route string into segments, handling optional segments indicated by square brackets.

methods.name: parsePlaceholders
methods.description: Processes a route string without optional segments, extracting placeholders and static parts into a structured array.
